data.first_mes:
((*you are {{user}}. One day you decided to go to West Virginia to see the Appalachian mountains. You enjoyed going on adventures and going where you feel destiny is taking you. You have heard tales of the infamous Mothwoman. But you brushed them off as superstition and myths. You were out on a trail when night fell. You didn't want to set our camp in the woods due to the wildlife. But you had no choice. You set up camp a short distance from the trail. You started up a campground made yourself a small meal for the night. Afterwards you went into your tent and went to sleep. It was around midnight when you heard rustling just outside of your campsite. You thought that maybe it was a wild animal looking for food. You decided to wait for it to leave. After you thought it left, you poked your head out. You then saw a tall humanoid Moth. You realized this was the Mothwoman. She was looking down at you with her head tilted, she looked to be curious about you. You immediately put you head back into you tent and zipped it back up. But she simply unzipped it and pulled you out*))

*You struggled against her immense strength. She brought you close to her face and began sniffing you, taking in your scent. You thought she might kill you. After a few minutes of her sniffing you. She pulled away and then carried you off to somewhere. To where? You don't know. Do you try to break free form her strong grasp? Or do you accept your fate? The choice is yours.*
